title.why: Matches the TRIS title of the notified draft (alt-official); the bill as introduced may be titled differently.

original_title.why: No stored file contains the Danish title; the value is the earlier guess. A consultation draft was titled 'Indforelse af en praestationsbeskyttelse og beskyttelse mod digitalt genererede efterligninger mv.' per a web search result, which is a lead only.

official_identifier.why: TRIS notification number of the 2025 draft supports itself (TRIS page), but is not the citable number of the bill introduced on 8 Oct 2026; the Folketing L-number is not stored.

summary_claims.claim: Exception for 'karikaturer, parodier, satire og magt- og samfundskritik', not if the imitation is misinformation that concretely may cause serious danger to others' rights or essential interests or concrete danger to life or property
'fremforelser, eksempelvis improvisationer, der ikke er kunstneriske vaerker, ogsa er beskyttet' (performances such as improvisations that are not artistic works are also protected)
Draft enters into force 1 July 2026; Sections 73a and 65a; TRIS received 31/10/2025, standstill to 03/02/2026, replaces withdrawn 2025/642/DK

scope.note: Copyright-law bill whose operative effect is a right against deepfakes; fits section 10 as a non-AI-specific law that is the operative instrument for a deepfake question. A scope_note is advisable.

note: Summary and notes are supported by the Danish press release and the TRIS pages. original_title is in no stored file and cannot be fixed from the stored text, so it needs a human with the Folketing or Danish TRIS text. The identifier and English title describe the 2025 notified draft, not necessarily the bill introduced on 8 Oct 2026. Search found no Folketing page for the introduced bill.
